## Description

Pairs time-varying copula dependency modeling with Quantile Regression Neural Networks (QRNN) to forecast conditional return distributions and capture non-linear tail alpha across stock universes.

## Where it may fit

Non-linear cross-sectional stock ranking, tail-risk alpha generation, volatile market regimes.

## Vehicles

Quantitative Equity Funds, Systematic Factor Investing Desks.

## Required data

Fundamental factor panels, daily return matrices, macroeconomic indicator time series.

## Caveats

Quantile crossing issues can occur if neural network quantile outputs are unconstrained.
